race.comment: DREAMZEL (1) won by the barest of margins last time at Sandown Hillside before another tough effort there when third in similar company. Still put up a good figure there and is very consistent at this trip. She'll land on speed and looks well placed to bounce back. CALL TO GLORY (2) disappointed here as a $3 chance last time out but had been going well enough prior and fresh for this can see him bounce back. WEAPON CLEAR (8) was behind DREAMZEL last time but was in the market there and can improve again. BEDOURIE (6) resumes with the profile to run well, look for him late in the piece. VAIN CHAMPAGNE (10) is another who will get back but comes back in class and can run well.
